recommendations.issue: Borrowed credibility scores 0 of 4. Replace vague praise with a named source, their role and the outcome they got.
recommendations.original: "Great service, highly recommend!"
recommendations.rewrite: "We cut month-end close from 9 days to 3." Priya Shah, Finance Director, Northwind Logistics

recommendations.issue: Competence and judgement scores 0 of 4. Replace what you were responsible for with what changed because of you: action verb, what you did, measurable result.
recommendations.original: We are passionate about helping our customers succeed.
recommendations.rewrite: Grew the engineering team from 6 to 25 and cut release time from monthly to daily.

recommendations.issue: Integrity and candour scores 0 of 4. Delete self-awarded praise (world-class, revolutionary) and replace it with the fact that would have earned it.
recommendations.original: Nexora is a revolutionary, world-class platform that empowers businesses to leverage data seamlessly.
recommendations.rewrite: A named engineer answers within 2 hours, 24/7.

recommendations.issue: Stakes: pain and desire scores 0 of 4. Describe the specific moment the reader realises the current way is not working, in their words.
recommendations.original: Accounting software for small businesses.
recommendations.rewrite: It is 11pm on the last day of the quarter and you are still matching receipts to bank lines.

recommendations.issue: Concreteness and vividness scores 0 of 4. Swap each abstract noun for something the reader can picture: a person, a moment, an object, a number.
recommendations.original: Welcome to Nexora Solutions
recommendations.rewrite: Your team sees every open ticket on one screen, so nobody chases updates in Slack.

recommendations.issue: Story and narrative scores 0 of 4. Insert a three-sentence story: who, what went wrong, what changed. Put it where the claim needs most belief.
recommendations.original: Our method improves retention.
recommendations.rewrite: Sam ran a gym losing 30 members a month. We changed one thing: a call on day 7. Churn halved by spring.

recommendations.issue: Specific claims and evidence scores 0 of 4. Replace every 'improved', 'faster', 'more' with a number, a time frame and a baseline.
recommendations.original: Studies show that data-driven companies are significantly more profitable.
recommendations.rewrite: Cut page load from 4.1s to 1.3s in six weeks.

recommendations.issue: Mechanism and reasoning scores 1 of 4. After each claim, add 'because...' or 'which means...'.
recommendations.original: Our coffee tastes better.
recommendations.rewrite: Our coffee tastes better because we roast to order and ship within 48 hours.

recommendations.issue: Objection handling scores 0 of 4. Name the sceptic's strongest objection and answer it with evidence. Two-sided beats one-sided for sceptical readers.
recommendations.original: (Price not mentioned)
recommendations.rewrite: Yes, we cost more than a freelancer. You are paying for a team that does not disappear in August.

recommendations.issue: Cost of delay scores 0 of 4. Show what staying put costs per week, month or year, using the reader's numbers where possible.
recommendations.original: Don't wait to fix your hiring process.
recommendations.rewrite: Each month a senior role stays open costs roughly [£X] in delayed delivery.

recommendations.issue: Genuine, shared urgency scores 0 of 4. Tie timing to something true: a deadline, a capacity limit, a season, a market shift. Delete fake urgency.
recommendations.original: Act now!
recommendations.rewrite: We take four new clients per quarter. Two Q1 places remain.

recommendations.issue: Hope and agency scores 1 of 4. After stating the stakes, show it can be done: a proof point, a first step, a reason for optimism. Urgency plus optimism moves people; urgency alone overwhelms them.
recommendations.original: Cyber attacks on firms like yours rose sharply last year. You are exposed.
recommendations.rewrite: Attacks on firms like yours are rising. The good news: three changes block most of them, and you can make the first one this week.

recommendations.issue: Mythos scores 0 of 4. Frame the message inside a bigger narrative: an old world, a shift, winners and losers, a promised land.
recommendations.original: We sell sales software.
recommendations.rewrite: Buyers now do 70% of their research before talking to sales. The teams winning have stopped pitching and started teaching.

recommendations.issue: Telos scores 1 of 4. Write the single sentence you want the reader to remember. Put it near the start, repeat it at the end, and cut anything that doesn't serve it.
recommendations.original: (Five equal points about features, pricing, history, team and roadmap)
recommendations.rewrite: One idea: we halve your onboarding time. Everything else is evidence for that.

recommendations.issue: Length scores 1 of 4. Cut anything that doesn't serve the one big idea; aim for the usual range for this content type.
recommendations.original: (A 600-word cold email)
recommendations.rewrite: (The same email at 120 words, with one ask)

recommendations.issue: Cohesion scores 1 of 4. Link ideas explicitly with connectives, repeat key terms instead of synonyms, and start paragraphs by picking up the last thread.
recommendations.original: Costs rose. Our team is experienced. Clients like us.
recommendations.rewrite: Costs rose, so clients need a partner who can deliver for less. That's where our experience helps.

recommendations.issue: Claims you can stand behind scores 2 of 4. Source each statistic, soften or cut claims you can't prove, and make comparisons specific and fair.
recommendations.original: Nexora is a revolutionary, world-class platform that empowers businesses to leverage data seamlessly.
recommendations.rewrite: Our 140 clients grew sales by a median of 18% in year one (2025 client survey).

recommendations.issue: First impression scores 1 of 4. Open with the reader's situation, a specific fact or the big idea; cut greetings-as-content and background.
recommendations.original: Welcome to Nexora Solutions
recommendations.rewrite: Your Q3 update mentioned the cloud migration twice.

recommendations.issue: Assumed knowledge scores 1 of 4. Spell out acronyms at first use, swap jargon for plain terms, and add one line of context where the reader might be lost.
recommendations.original: Our MLOps CoE will uplift your TCO via KPIs.
recommendations.rewrite: Our machine-learning team will cut the total cost of running your models.

Contact us to learn more.
